title: Samsung FlexWash — Manual check mode
description: Manual Smart Install — press Delay End to advance component tests.

steps.title: Enter manual check
steps.body: From AS: press Delay End. Each press advances: 1 door lock, 2 drain, 3 prep valve, Co cold, Ho hot, 6 water shot/heater/rinse, 7 drain, 8 spin, 9 dry heater/fan, 10 door. OK(Ot) = pass; nG = fail.
